provenance.size_rationale: 48^3 (~110k cells) x ~260 timesteps combining three owned production paths in one run is the largest/most combined workload in this leaf, justifying the acceleration label; smaller isolated checks (laser-3d-wavelength-smoke, window-shift-cadence-grid-advance, injector-flux-density-drift) already establish and justify each sub-observable's tolerance individually.

policy.shape: Three independently recomputed observables on the same run: laser period (zero-crossing, pre-window-start only), window grid-min trajectory (fraction-accumulator recursion restarted at window_start_time), and injected Beam px (near drift_px, temperature=0 at creation).
policy.tolerance_origin: Identical to the three isolated checks that establish each bound: 15% period (laser-3d-wavelength-smoke), 0.5*dx position (window-shift-cadence-grid-advance's own fraction-accumulator recursion), and PX_RTOL from injector-flux-density-drift's self-field formula (space_charge_growing_slab_dp()), evaluated at this deck's own T_END=20fs worst-case residency, giving PX_RTOL~=2.57e-4. Post-repair (v11): the position criterion's delayed-window-start call label (the start_step fed to window_shift_predicted_by_dump_step) is now derived from this deck's nonrestart epoch3d.F90 half-step time stagger (dt/2 before the first output, then dt/2 before/after each subsequent output_routines() call -- lines 123, 159-163, 265-278) instead of round(window_start_time/dt); window.F90's moving_window() (lines 402-430) only observes time=dt/2+n*dt on its n-th call, so the first call visible to a delayed (>0) window_start_time is n=ceil(window_start_time/dt-0.5), 0-based call label L=n-1. round() undercounted this by exactly one call for this deck's non-integer window_start_time/dt~=68.163, producing a one-dx (POSITION_TOL-exceeding) grid-min error; the half-step-derived label matches to floating-point error instead. Post-repair (v8): dt_snapshot was raised from 2fs to 0.2fs -- 2fs exactly equalled ANALYTIC_PERIOD=lambda/c=2fs for this deck's 0.6-micron laser, aliasing the pre-window-start Ey(t) samples to ~1 sample/period (indistinguishable from DC, the root cause of v7's 'found only 0 pre-window-start zero crossings' error); 0.2fs gives ~10 samples/period, matching the ~9 samples/period ratio the sibling laser-3d-wavelength-smoke check uses for its own (different-wavelength) laser. This dt_snapshot change requires a fresh run; no other deck field changed.
policy.determinism: temperature=0 injector species (no random momentum spread at creation); single rank; fully deterministic.

criteria.name: window_grid_trajectory
criteria.rule: max |actual - predicted| grid-min <= 0.5*dx after window_start_time, both sides, where the predicted trajectory's delayed-start call label is derived from epoch3d.F90's half-step time stagger (n=ceil(window_start_time/dt-0.5), 0-based label L=n-1), not round(window_start_time/dt)

criteria.name: injector_near_momentum
criteria.rule: sampled at the latest dump (scanning newest-to-oldest) that still contains a nonempty Px+Beam block -- not the final dump, which legitimately has none once the x_max injector stops at window_start_time=6fs and all injected Beam particles have outflowed by t_end=20fs -- max relative |px-drift_px| <= 5*space_charge_growing_slab_dp(1e20,Q0,eps0,v_inject,20fs)/drift_px (~2.57e-4) and particle count >= 1 at that dump, both sides; a run with zero nonempty Beam Px dumps anywhere fails
